part.text:
Fixed duplicate handling during XOR chunk byte-size rollover in `tsdb/head_append.go`.

The append preprocessor now checks `c.maxTime >= t` before creating the next chunk when the current chunk exceeds its byte limit. This discards duplicate/out-of-order samples rather than inserting one as the first sample of a new chunk, preventing overlapping chunk boundaries.
